instruction: Look at freecad_task-16_input.step in FreeCAD. At the start of the task, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-16_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. For each support post, create one coaxial blind hole from the top face downward. Each blind hole has diameter 3 mm and depth 8 mm and must not pass through the base plate. Export the part with four blind holes as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-16_output.step.
